extraction.notes: RUN-2026-02 stage 5 sample. Read the table of contents, the whole of 1.2 Summary, the Cluster 2 introduction (page 74) and the full Chapter 2 section (pages 76-77), and screened every other section with technology keywords, reading the passages found. Chapter 2 appears in the summary (page 8), the Cluster 2 introduction and the chapter section; each is extracted separately. Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one. Period covered from footnote 4 (June 2022 to June 2023). Left out under the materiality test: cybercrime (Chapter 24 and Chapter 23 Convention on Cybercrime), media and online media regulation, digital finance, tax and customs IT upgrades not tied to EU systems, the e-Declaration Portal, agriculture e-governance and veterinary systems, digital tachographs, the child protection information system, digital skills recommendations, and the statistical annex; Annex I has no in-scope technology passages. Doubtful cases are flagged theme_doubtful.
